scope: Evidence and captures only; archived executables omitted because historical archives lack complete third-party binary redistribution notice sets. Original archives remain preserved privately; public source pins permit rebuild.

packages.preservation: Every remaining original regular-file payload is copied byte-for-byte. Added release metadata is under _PUBLIC_RELEASE. Original manifests retain excluded executable entries as historical records.
packages.full_original_retention: Original exact archive remains in the existing private Hugging Face dataset; no visibility change.
packages.new_archive_sha256: Recorded externally in release-exclusions.json and release checksums; self-referential archive hashes are not embedded.
